payload.question: Did the savings the council promised actually happen?
payload.label: £3.2m of permanent savings and extra income in 2025/26

target.display: "Permanent savings and additional income of £3.2 million have been identified in 2025 - 2026." — General Fund MTFS and 2025-2026 Budget, the report that set that year's budget

payload.council_caveat: The council does hold a budget risk reserve, then £1.8m, explicitly "to provide resilience against emerging pressures and delays in the delivery of savings", so it tracks the risk internally even though it does not publish the result.
payload.evidence: The council said it had found £3.2m of savings for 2025/26. Neither the accounts for that year nor any outturn report we found says how much of it actually arrived. This is the single biggest hole in what Norwich publishes about its own money.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
